rootCause: The regression proves lazy site.auth() cannot capture script-scoped authentication when element creation is delayed. The live host still fails to deliver a usable token after this fix, so this is not established as the complete live root cause.
fix: Capture site.auth() synchronously during the registered widget script; retain one cached SDK client and reuse the captured strategy.

regression.name: bundled entry captures script-scoped Wix authentication before a widget is inserted later
regression.command: pnpm --dir integrations/wix exec node --test --test-name-pattern="captures script-scoped" tests/sdk.test.js
regression.seam: Actual bundled Wix SDK executed as a script, then delayed custom-element insertion. No manual token injection.

validation.databaseSkippedReason: No WIX_BILLING_TEST_DATABASE_URL, no SQL/executor source changed; historical PostgreSQL qualification retained separately.
